component.name: Swiftify
component.summary: A light music player for Spotify and YouTube Music

description.p: Swiftify plays your Spotify or YouTube Music library in a Material 3 Expressive window, with an immersive player, synced lyrics, visualizers, an equalizer and local files with editable tags. It runs far lighter than Spotify's own client.

Spotify needs a Premium account and your own Spotify client id. YouTube Music searches and plays signed out; your library and history need the cookies of a signed-in browser tab. Nothing is sent anywhere but the music service you chose.
